brief: Conduct a load transfer to reduce demand on the Kingsley Green 138/13kV transformer, as the unit is approaching its temperature limit during the heat event [ERP-032]. Assess the receiving asset's available capacity by applying the ambient de-rating set out in MG-021 to both assets [ERP-032]. Ensure the receiving asset is confirmed to be free of known cooling or oil defects prior to switching [ERP-032]. Monitor top oil temperature on the receiving asset for the following six hours after the transfer [ERP-032].
